evolution.hypothesis: Controlling the spatial distribution of Ag/Cu interfaces may influence ethylene selectivity.
evolution.experimental_plan: Prepare catalysts with systematically varied Ag/Cu interface density while controlling composition, loading, and testing conditions.

evolution.primary_risk: Ag/Cu interface density may covary with Ag loading, particle size and exposed Cu surface area.
evolution.alternative_explanation: Changes in ethylene selectivity may originate from surface composition or catalyst restructuring rather than interface density alone.

evolution.hypothesis: Modifying pore morphology in Cu-Ag catalysts may influence local transport and C2 selectivity.
evolution.experimental_plan: Prepare comparable Cu-Ag catalysts with different pore structures and measure ethylene and ethanol selectivity under matched operating conditions.
